TYPE rows: donor type -> target type (global, whole word). SCOPED_TYPE rows: <donor path>#<Type> -> target type for that one file. JNI rows: JNI symbol / javac -h header-name prefix. LITERAL rows: declared string tokens. EXTERNAL rows: non-JDK packages imported unchanged (JUnit 5). DROP rows: <donor path> -> sha256 of one donor line removed. REWRITE rows: <donor path> -> <name>[=count] (rewrites/<name>.before -> rewrites/<name>.after, the declared adapter changes; nothing else changes a body). SEAL rows: donor source-custody manifest -> regenerated manifest of the relocated fixtures. NAMING rows: schema-relevant renames of the naming stage (jdk_naming.py rewrite_text applied by the recipe; comment-line product names M3JDK21 -> M3JDK 21 and test-input paths com/m3/ -> jdk/m3/ are the other naming rewrites, counted per file in PROVENANCE.tsv). NEC rows: donor files whose equivalence with an existing M3JDK owner is NOT decided (held, nothing copied, blob pinned; Phase A of this leaf, see PHASE_A_NEC.tsv). OMIT rows: donor files left out by decision (nothing copied; blob pinned).
